name: movia-website
description: MOVIA — public website (Home, About Us, Join Us). Astro static site on Cloudflare Pages with a D1-backed interest form.

scripts.preview: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist
scripts.db:export: wrangler d1 execute movia-interest --remote --command "SELECT * FROM interest ORDER BY created_at DESC" --json > interest-export.json
